name: Human Agency Release Gate

stages.R0: Outcome — name the human/customer/user outcome and scope.
stages.R1: Evidence — representative inputs, provenance and expected truth.
stages.R2: Authority — permissions, safety, privacy, failure and approval boundaries.
stages.R3: Reliability — deterministic tests, regressions, economics, latency or experience quality.
stages.R4: Reality — a real human, customer, reviewer or external system result.

rules: Every release must represent R0 through R4.
A blocking gate prevents PASS until it passes.
R4 can never be owned by automation.
Synthetic or automated evidence can never satisfy R4 by itself.
PASS requires evidence matching the gate owner.
Missing real-world evidence produces REVIEW, not a fabricated PASS.
